notes.title: Major Demo Update for Tiny Teams Festival
notes.notes:
[p]The 2025 Tiny Teams festival, hosted by Yogscast Games, has just started, and will run until August 14th! With it comes a huge update to the Moonsigil Atlas demo, and some exclusive content you might see on Twitch streams in the next week.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's in the demo update?[/h2][p]Here's some of the new content in the demo [b]you can play now[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Eclipse levels[/b] for additional difficulty modifiers once you've beaten the demo[/p][/*][*][p][b]New encounters[/b], including Astral Card Packs and new forms of infusing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved visuals[/b] for the player character and encounters[/p][/*][*][p][b]Even more[/b], including starting boons, character mastery, run history, Astral Dust, new cards, and a lot of small quality-of-life improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Catch us on the Yogscast stream[/h2][p]Want to see even more of the game, or chat with the developers? Our game will be featured on the Yogscast Twitch stream during the festival:[/p][list][*][p][b]Date: [/b]Monday, August 11, during the 5-8pm BST time slot (12-3pm EDT)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twitch:  [/b][url="http://twitch.tv/yogscast"]http://twitch.tv/yogscast[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Youtube: [/b][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam: [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Yogscast will be streaming exclusive content from the full game, so keep an eye out for [b]the third playable character Tark'thul [/b]and additional enemies, bosses, and encounters in [b]Act 2.[/b] We will be in Twitch chat and happy to talk about the game![/p][p][/p][h2]More Tiny Teams[/h2][p]Tiny Teams is a festival all about games made by teams smaller than 5 people, or even individual developers. In the past, it's featured games like Stardew Valley, Balatro, Phasmophobia, Vampire Survivors, and many others!  Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams store page[/url] to play more demos from hidden indie gems, or catch discounts on established indie titles until August 14th! [/p][p]
[b]Thanks for your support!

[/b]Jeremy and Daniel
Snake Tower Games[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming: Tiny Teams Festival and Massive Demo Update
notes.notes:
[p]We are very excited to announce that Moonsigil Atlas will be featured in the Tiny Teams festival next week, hosted by Yogscast Games! There will also be a huge update to the public demo on August 7, the first day of the festival.
[/p][p]Here's what you can expect in the August 7th update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Eclipse levels[/b] for additional difficulty modifiers once you've beaten the demo[/p][/*][*][p][b]New encounters[/b], including Astral Card Packs and new forms of infusing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved visuals[/b] for the player character and encounters[/p][/*][*][p][b]Even more[/b], including starting boons, character mastery, run history, Astral Dust, new cards, and a lot of small quality-of-life improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, keep an eye out for anyone streaming Moonsigil Atlas during Tiny Teams - you might catch some gameplay of [b]the new playable character, Tark'thul,[/b] and additional content that won't be available in the demo![/p][p]If you're interested in participating in the closed playtest, where we make weekly updates to the game based on your feedback, please [url="https://discord.com/invite/jrsaB4EStv"]join our Discord server[/url]. Thanks so much to all the playtesters who have already contributed.[/p]

notes.title: Moonsigil Atlas Playtest Update - Version 0.0.4
notes.notes:
We've just made the first update to the Moonsigil Atlas playtest. This update adds [b]new map encounters[/b], two [b]new card keywords[/b], and several [b]new cards[/b]. The new version also includes bug fixes, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements.

We'll be aiming to release playtest updates every Friday. The updates will vary in size (some features take more than a week to develop) but at minimum, we'll be getting out quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes every week.

If you want to [b]play the game as soon as possible[/b], we're giving priority access to playtesters who sign up through our [b][url=https://discord.gg/jrsaB4EStv]Discord server[/url][/b]. You can also use Discord to directly submit bug reports, request features, and join discussions about strategy. Otherwise, we'll be rolling out access to Steam sign-ups over time as we improve the game.

Thanks,
Daniel and Jeremy

[h2]Change Log - Playtest Version 0.0.4[/h2]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New type of map encounter added -> Upgrading cards with keywords
[*] Added "Bolster" card attribute
[*] Added "Prepared" card keyword
[*] Added "Prepared" to Expose weakness and Paraselene
[*] Barbed Buckler has been reworked to use "Bolster"
[*] Added new SFX
[*] Added new card: Cultivate
[*] Added new card: Safeguard
[*] Added new card: Keystone
[/list]
[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduce the cost of Refresh
[*] Make Enervate a bit bigger and apply more Exposed per turn
[*] Changed the shape of the "Shackle" hostile sigils placed in an Elite fight
[*] Slightly reduced Feldryn's max health
[*] Slightly increased healing from the heal map encounter
[*] Improved the quality of cards given in an Astral Gem card reward
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add a warning when you try to change the shape of a card that transforms
[*] Add a version number to the settings menu
[*] Made version number significantly more human-readable
[*] "Save and Quit" button now quits to the main menu
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sage's Mettle applies Shield to the right region when triggered with Korlim's Verse
[*] Refresh works as expected in combination with Stargaze
[*] Refresh works as expected in combination with Duplicate
[*] Cards in browsers should no longer disappear after doing multiple runs
[*] "Bolt" should now draw properly in the tooltip for "Thunderbolt" after doing multiple runs
[*] Focus no longer increases damage dealt directly to the player
[*] Adjacency effects are now removed when cards transform (e.g. Debris)
[*] "Move On" options in map encounters are now properly displaying 
[*] Rune impact SFX now plays
[*] Fixed audio bug where multiple sigil removal SFX could play after ending combat
[*] Fixed audio bug where negative status effects were playing the positive status effect SFX
[*] Fixed audio bug where status effect SFX could be played multiple times
[*] Fixed bug where tooltiped card animations can fail
[*] Wishlist button now opens Steam overlay instead of the default web browser
[*] Fixed run timer calculating time incorrectly (not currently visible to players)
[*] Fixed issue with boss sigil placement logic (minor balance implications)
[*] Fixed rare null reference exception on status effect animator
[*] Fixed rare null reference exception on card keyword animator
[/list]
